# truenas_resilver_config (Resource)

Manages the TrueNAS pool resilver priority schedule (pool.resilver). This is a singleton resource — there is exactly one resilver schedule per TrueNAS system, so it is never created or deleted on TrueNAS; Terraform create/update calls pool.resilver.update, and Terraform delete only removes the resource from state (the configuration is left in place).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pool resilver priority schedule — SINGLETON. Declare at most one per config.
resource "truenas_resilver_config" "config" {
  enabled = true
  begin   = "18:00"
  end     = "09:00" # rolls over midnight
  weekday = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `begin` (String) Time when the resilver operations window begins, 24-hour "HH:MM" format (e.g. "18:00").
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the resilver schedule is enabled.
- `end` (String) Time when the resilver operations window ends, 24-hour "HH:MM" format (e.g. "09:00"). If earlier than begin, the window rolls over midnight.
- `weekday` (List of Number) Weekdays when resilver operations are allowed, crontab(5) values 1 (Monday) through 7 (Sunday).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton resource: always "resilver_config".
